experiment: Rust PDFium extraction feasibility versus the existing Python PyMuPDF pipeline
attribution: Source: European Medicines Agency (EMA), EPAR product information. Extracted text and cell excerpts in this result remain attributed to EMA.
scope_warning: Extraction/layout feasibility only, not a ported-parser parity claim. The Rust probe returns Unicode glyphs, positions, bounding boxes and font weights; it does not split SmPC sections, recognize first copies, detect tables or associate frequency labels. The table-cell diagnostic deliberately borrows PyMuPDF TableFinder cell rectangles and the existing Python flatten_table_rows() function, so it does not establish a native Rust table parser.

tolerances_and_pass_criteria.text_comparison: per-page Unicode NFKC + casefold character multiset, whitespace ignored; recall >= 0.98
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.greek_comparison: same character multiset restricted to Greek letters; paired EN/EL docs and Greek recall >= 0.98
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.page_comparison: exact PyMuPDF/PDFium page-count match, all nonempty reference pages >= 0.90 character recall, and page-size deltas <= 0.5 pt
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.layout_lines: PDFium glyph origins grouped on baselines within 2.5 pt; exact line recall is reported, not used as parser-parity evidence
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.first_copy_headings: same-page normalized heading text recall >= 0.90; tested against Python parser's accepted first-copy headings
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.table_cells: glyph bbox center inside PyMuPDF cell rectangle, no geometry expansion; alpha-numeric cell character recall >= 0.95
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.frequency_associations: reaction-cell alphanumeric character multiset plus normalized frequency label (recognized English/Greek column headers; punctuation and order ignored) recall >= 0.95; exact flattened-row text recall is separately reported
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.bold_cells: PDFium font-weight >= 650 is bold; compare against PyMuPDF page-span/table-cell overlap flags
tolerances_and_pass_criteria.independent_oracle: Xarelto EN expectations copied from tests/test_m1_acceptance.py:208-264; Anaemia/Common, Thrombocytosis/Uncommon, Eye haemorrhage/Common, Hypotension/Common; no Anaemia/Thrombocytosis glue; three SOC headings remain unbanded
